evidence: One commenter strongly recommended it for quick plant identification; another used it on a mystery houseplant.

evidence_sources.author: iammjm
evidence_sources.excerpt: I can strongly recommend the mobile app Flora Incognita for quickly identifying plants. It’s made by one of the German universities so it’s free, don’t have ads, and don’t collect your personal data. I even showed it to my mum and she loves it

evidence_sources.author: otherayden
evidence_sources.excerpt: Thank you for the rec, I used it to identify a mystery house plant I was gifted :)
